about.title: Building software, and learning how to break and defend it.
paras: I study Computer Science with a specialisation in Cyber Security. My time splits between shipping full-stack web applications and working through forensics and CTF problems.

My internship gave me four months of on-site, Agile team experience building responsive front ends, REST APIs and database-backed features with the MERN stack. Outside class I practise data structures and algorithms on SkillRack and LeetCode.

experience.title: Full-Stack Developer Intern
experience.summary: Developed responsive web applications, REST APIs and database solutions while collaborating with a team in an Agile development environment.

projects.title: Forensics CTF Challenge
projects.desc: A steganography-based CTF challenge. Players analyse an image file, detect its hidden layers and extract the embedded flag. Focused on digital forensics, hidden data extraction and investigative problem-solving.

projects.title: Chat Monitor
projects.desc: An AI-based monitoring tool that scans chat conversations in real time to detect offensive, abusive or suspicious messages. It helps keep educational and collaborative platforms safe and respectful.

projects.title: Car Pooling System
projects.desc: A web and mobile platform that connects drivers who have empty seats with passengers heading the same way. It promotes cost-effective travel, reduces fuel use and helps ease traffic congestion and pollution.
